com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Change setup goals, preferred accounting destination, currency, locale, timezone or routine-work preferences. Currency preferences leave document amounts unchanged. Provider connections, tax treatment and automatic export are managed separately in IPP. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview setting our setup goal to review, bookkeeping currency to USD, locale to en-US and timezone to America/New_York. Explain that these preferences leave document amounts unchanged, then wait for my confirmation.
Preview marking our intake and automation routine choices as manual. Show only those preference changes and wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_update_workspace_preferences, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare setup goal, preferred provider, currency/locale/timezone or routine choices. Does not connect a provider, change tax treatment or enable automatic export. Requires confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
